nodes.title: Crisis-line and manipulation checks on agent config live in shared/safety's lint, read by both doors: rules.json lint.T-L6 (crisis lines, plus a neverSay entry that would hide them) and lint.T-L7 (manipulation, with negated_prefix tested on the text before each match). agents/guard.ts delegates (T-L1 to ai_honesty or disclosure, T-L6 to crisis_lines, T-L7 to manipulation); its local regexes are gone. One source of truth. lintAgentConfig now refuses these everywhere it runs (compile, campaign gate, learning gates), not only on draft writes.
nodes.reverse_if: Never: weakening the regex door is not allowed; tighten it with DEV evidence instead.
